Package org.osgi.dmt.ddf

Interface NODE

All Known Subinterfaces:
AddableMAP<K,V>, MAP<K,V>, MutableMAP<K,V>, Opt<T>
public interface NODE
The NODE represents a node in the Device Management Tree.
